question: Determine strict, peripheral and equivariant central lifts; evaluate all original G31 quarterclocks, integral monodromies, and compare actual sign-lift and reflection groups.
scope: Original 60 G31 reflections, four ordered punctures, 17 simultaneous conjugacy classes, 62 exact-order-four clock markings; existing central Z4 extension with determinant cocycle. Relaxed transport equations and equivalence are explicitly defined. No identification with noncentral lattice lifts or the effective diagonal quotient.
new_theorems: For the existing determinant extension and C_m*C_m images with opposite determinant parity, strict lifts exist exactly when 8 divides m, with 16 based lifts when they exist.
All 62 quarterclock classes obstruct:30 yield(0,2),32 yield(2,0).
Central covariance defects d=1,3 give960 classes with strict lifted clock and1984 with central clock power; relaxing clock power alone gives none.
Actual groups have no embeddings either direction; common quotients are precisely1,C2; explicit E8 isometry and clock-preserving quotient map are supplied.
No nonzero G31-equivariant sign-kernel pushout to trivial Z4 exists; full clock marking requires centralizer orbit beyond spectrum/cohomology/obstruction.
standard_tools_reused: Central extensions classified by group H2 and lift torsors H1
Orbifold fundamental group of an oriented punctured surface
Smith normal form for integral local coefficients
Frattini lemma for finite p groups
